preservation: Only listed sentences change. Every other useful narration passage and its PCM remain intact, in the same order.

changes.ko: 스트리트 파이터 식스에서 주리는 상대의 공격을 받아 두 발이 뜹니다. 체력 막대를 가려도 등과 무릎의 각도가 바뀌어서 맞은 쪽을 찾을 수 있죠.
changes.en: In Street Fighter 6, Juri takes a hit and both feet leave the ground. Even with the health bar hidden, the changing angles of her back and knees show which character was hit.
changes.continuity: 001–002 establish a readable hit;003 demonstrates it on Juri;004 preserves the same roadmap.

changes.ko: 슈퍼 마리오 오디세이에서 마리오가 선인장에 닿는 모습을 보세요. 짧은 팔다리가 둥근 몸통 가까이에 모였다가 다시 펴지며 충격과 회복을 보여 줍니다.
changes.en: Watch Mario touch a cactus in Super Mario Odyssey. His short limbs draw close to his rounded body, then extend again to show the impact and recovery.
changes.continuity: 051–052 introduce body proportions;053 provides a round, short-limbed character;054–058 retain the need to adapt motion to each body. No shared game skeleton is claimed.
